_from: docs/game-guide/templates/art-config.json. Mine Runner rock textures (docs/MINE-ART-PLAN.md). Check with: python3 scripts/game_art.py mine paint OUT --dry-run

styles.rock: Stylised hand-painted video game texture, painterly brush strokes, soft even light with no strong shadows, rich but gentle colours, clean and readable, made for a children's 3D game.

pictures.name: rock-1
pictures.prompt: Rough grey-green cave rock wall with thin veins and small flecks of glossy deep-green pounamu greenstone running through it, damp and cool. Seen straight on, flat, filling the whole frame edge to edge, even all over with no single focal point, no objects, no tools, no people, no text, no border, no vignette, no perspective. Seamless tileable texture.
